apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(skin): build the GitHub skin download only where reqwest is linked (`587c6940`)
- feat(skin): show the full stylesheet in the Custom CSS editor and scroll inside it (`8b2f6c55`)
- feat(skin): add an in-app Custom CSS editor that restyles the app as you type (`163f743a`)
- feat(skin): load FLUXA_SKIN folders in release builds and reload them on save (`f854ca5e`)
- fix(skin): truncate calendar cell titles, stack the add-on form on mobile and pad settings above the nav bar (`03404fde`)
- fix(preview): open detail as a screen outside desktop in modal previews (`a8bdcc70`)
- fix(host): keep a pending resize until the GPU exists (`fcfca677`)
- fix(player): darken the loading scrim and brighten the status text (`f7a50490`)
- fix(modal): use a five-stop hero fade (`bd5da39c`)
- fix(skin): skip invalid style rules instead of dropping the sheet and allow up to 16 gradient stops (`49d71209`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.8...v0.3.9
